_notes: UQM 0.8.0's own system groups, recorded by running solarsys.c's InitSolarSys and IP_frame (their drawing left out) with ipdisp.c, grpinfo.c (the group files in memory, state.c) and process.c's RedrawQueue (see tools/extract/golden/groups.c), after a new game (UQM's own InitGameStructures, InitGameClock, AddInitialGameEvents, InitGroupInfo). Each visit seeds TFB_Random, then the generator's initNpcs (BuildGroups, GetGroupInfo; init_probe at Sol, the colony's guard), ResetSolarSys (DoMissions), and IP_frame's frames with a test pilot's keys. A meeting (START_ENCOUNTER) is followed as the game comes back from a talk without a battle (UninitSolarSys's GetGroupInfo, BuildBattle's ESCAPE_COUNTER, a new SOLARSYS_STATE, InitSolarSys coming back with reinitNpcs: check_probe at Sol, ResetSolarSys). Leaving runs uninitNpcs; the next visit's days then pass on the clock's fields (no events).
Contact is found with the masks of a system's sheets (sheets) from the official content package (SHA-256 77d75ac25e6fb755a33c4ba3b38a7b7bc41fcbc02896891b0cc9ac9214b72eef). Everything else is code.

input: each scenario's flagship (fusion thrusters, turning jets), date, game states set (0 PROBE_MESSAGE_DELIVERED, 1 SLYLANDRO_MULTIPLIER, 2 UTWIG_SUPOX_MISSION, 3 STARBASE_AVAILABLE), fleets changed [race, actual_strength, x, y], whether the drone's group is made gone, and visits [star, seed, days before, goals [kind, arg, frames]] (0 a planet, 1 the nearest group drawn, 2 wait, 3 out of the system, 4 away from the nearest group, 5 the middle of the screen). Entering orbit comes back to flight at once, as EnterPlanetOrbit does around the orbit. A visit's fifth field, its meetings' ends in turn (stage 3b-1 item 5): [status, seed, crews]: status 1 a battle, the group's ships as GetGroupInfo read them given those crews (-1 as it is, 0 destroyed), UninitEncounter (EncounterRace the first ship's race, the destroyed gone), TFB_Random seeded from seed (Battle's), then the game coming back as from a talk; a meeting past them a talk.

visits: [star, frames], a frame recorded after RedrawQueue: [keys (1 left, 2 right, 4 thrust), facing, ip_location x, y, ShipStamp x, y, zoom radius, inner planet or -1, event (0, 1 met, 2 left the system, 3 orbit), the functions that drew a number since the last frame (the first frame's: initNpcs' too), TFB_Random's seed, the elements' order (group_id each), the groups (ip_group_q)], with the group met (EncounterGroup) last on a meeting's frame. A group: [group_id, race_id, sys_loc, task, dest_loc, orbit_pos, group_counter, in_system, loc x, y, element]; element null or [state_flags, life_span, thrust_wait, TravelAngle, vector w, h, fract w, h, error w, h, incr w, h, current x, y, next x, y (display units, the space's offset taken out), primitive type].
